Subject: Re: PoC timeline check-in

Hey Hannah,

Quick update from our side: the integration sprint hit a blocker during the connector handoff. Our eng lead found a data shape mismatch with the onboarding webhook that will take at least one more week to fix (plus QA). We were hoping to finish the PoC this week and move to the demo, but the schedule shifted.

Given the delay, could Redwood extend the trial window by 10 days and add a small sandbox credit so we don’t hit usage limits while we iterate? We’ve attached the error log and a short summary of the failing calls.

Appreciate any runway you can give — we’re excited about the low-latency results so far, just need a little more time to finish the adapter.

Thanks,
Aamir
